! Game text
| Deploy on your side of table. At any time, you may move one of your character weapons from any site to the Blaster Rack. During your deploy phase, weapon may be re-deployed for an expenditure of Force equal to the weapon's deploy cost. || Deploy on your side of table. At any time, you may {{Errata hl|transfer}} one of your character weapons from any site to the Blaster Rack. During your deploy phase, weapon may be {{Errata hl|transferred to your character on table}} for an expenditure of Force equal to the weapon's deploy cost.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English Decipher-era [[Blaster Rack]] original and PC Errata articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata (omit missing). Do not transclude onto Unlimited, Japanese, Two-Player, foil, or (V). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged.
